request.title: A sperm whale on the church floor
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: inside a cold stone church in the frost-bound city of Nogratis, pews scattered, icy stained glass. A full-size sperm whale lies beached across the church floor, enormous and bewildered, while a towering ice devil of jagged blue ice rears up on the far side of it. In front of the whale, Nate: a human warlock and pirate with long wild red hair and stubble, wearing a dark navy captain's coat over a loose white shirt with leather straps; he leans back with his arms crossed and a smug grin, as if daring the devil to try him. Comedy played straight, epic scale.

references.role: Character appearance reference for Nate. Preserve the face, hair, build, colours and outfit shown; ignore the background, base and any interface elements.

request.alt: Nate, a red-haired pirate warlock, stands smugly with arms crossed before a sperm whale beached on a church floor, facing an ice devil.
